title: Hầm mộ
about: Round k2 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian): gothic, C minor at 46 bpm, a far choir on "oo" over the dark pad and a drone, a low bell tolling on each new chord, the D flat of the Phrygian mode darkening the close. No tune but the choir's slow moving tones and a few glass notes. An original piece.
